title: Ordinary relative ampleness supplies a canonical SectionProjModel on a scheme chart
statement: Let $X$ be an algebraic space over a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme; def-trf-algebraic-space], $L$ a line module on $X$, $T$ an $S$-scheme, $V$ an etale scheme chart of $X$, and $p:V\to T$ a scheme map. Let $H$ be an ordinary invertible module on $V$ [def-sc-invertible-module], with an OrdinaryEtaleIdentification of $H$ with $L$ restricted to $V$ [def-sfb-ordinary-etale-identification]. Suppose $H$ is ample on the inverse image of every affine open of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], using open tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then there exist a SectionProjModel $A$ for $h_p$ and the pullback of $\operatorname{lineTestFamily}(X,L)$ [def-trf-space-line-module-proj-input; lem-trf-section-proj-etale-embedding], and a map $r:V\to\operatorname{Proj}_T(A.\mathrm{affine})$, such that the evaluation generation open is all of $V$, $r$ satisfies the canonical chart formula, and $r$ is an open immersion. The model identifies actual homogeneous sections, products, units and restrictions, with evaluation fixed on homogeneous sections.

proof.text: Ampleness makes every inverse image of an affine base open quasi-compact. Thus p is quasi-compact, and the forward scheme canonical-Proj criterion supplies the ordinary RelativeSectionAlgebra, everywhere generation and open canonical immersion.

The given OrdinaryEtaleIdentification and the cartesian line realization identify H and all its tensor powers with the scheme-test family. On affine base opens take the canonical comparisons of ordinary sections with compatible chart sections. The ordinary/etale tensor and counit comparisons preserve products, the degree-zero unit and restrictions, giving the sections and degreeIso fields of SectionProjModel. Evaluation is tensor unit insertion on every homogeneous section, giving evaluation_eq.

Transport the everywhere generation and canonical chart formula from the ordinary model through these homogeneous and tensor comparisons. The map r is the same ordinary scheme morphism, so it remains an open immersion. Empty charts are included because the pointwise generation condition is vacuous there.

theorem exists_sectionProjModel_of_ample_chart
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (L : X.Modules) (hL : X.IsLineModule L)
    (T : Over S) (V : X.EtaleSite) (p : V.obj.left ⟶ T)
    (H : (X.etaleForget.obj V).Modules) (hH : H.IsInvertible)
    (identification : OrdinaryEtaleIdentification X V L H)
    (hample : ∀ W : T.left.Opens, IsAffineOpen W →
      ∃ h : ((tensorPullback (p.left ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj H).IsInvertible,
        @IsAmple (p.left ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
          ((tensorPullback (p.left ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj H) h) :
    ∃ A : SectionProjModel (yoneda.map p) ((lineTestFamily X L hL).pullback V.obj.hom),
      ∃ r : V.obj.left ⟶ projOver T A.affine,
        A.evaluation.IsGenerationOpen ⊤ ∧
          A.evaluation.IsCanonicalMap ⊤
            ((⊤ : Subfunctor (yoneda.obj V.obj.left)).ι ≫ yoneda.map r) ∧
          IsOpenImmersion r.left
